From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + next steps (VPC / private deploy)

Hi Jordan / Sam,

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciate the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

What I heard: 
- Primary goal: move model inference for customer-facing features into a private environment to ensure data segregation and compliance (PII + payment data).
- Scale: ~200-300 qps peak, avg 20-30 qps; bursty daytime traffic.
- Latency target: p50 < 120ms; p95 < 350ms for inference.
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 is required; will need audit logs, KMS integration, and IP allowlisting.
- Timeline: target pilot in Q3, production H2 if pilot successful.

Redwood fit / options we discussed: 
- Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) for predictable throughput and isolation.
- Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem) for full network isolation and customer-managed keys.

Immediate next steps I proposed: 
1) Share VPC/private overview deck + architecture checklist (I'll attach).
2) Schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive with our SE (recommended) to walk infra and security details.
3) I'll send a ballpark SOW/procurement checklist you can share with procurement.

I'll attach the VPC overview and a short checklist in the follow-up email and would love to lock a time for the technical dive next week if that works. 

Thanks,
